title: Textual absence claims sweep

selection.screening: Case-insensitive negative/restrictive language: not, no, never, without, only, neither/nor, nothing, absence, lack, silence/silent, omit, unspecified/undefined and equivalents; read in context to select assertions that the cited text or a delimited passage/version lacks a topic, term, argument, mechanism, estimate, attribution or documentary metadata. Includes passage-level and attributed scope limits so that a limit is not mistaken for whole-text silence. Selection is intentionally inclusive.
exclusions: Negation inside the proposition being answered, rather than an editorial assertion about its text.
Retrieval/inspection failures and statements about what a previous search or audit found, unless they assert a specific passage is absent in a named retrieved version.
Caveats about reality, implementation, validity, influence or what the dataset record proves, rather than what a cited text contains.
Bare predicate/category distinctions without a claim of missing textual content; source-role/voice labels alone; only this passage was recorded/cited/read.
Earliest located is a bounded search result, rather than an assertion that no earlier text exists.

cohorts.name: topic-exclusion supplement
cohorts.reason: Boundary re-screen includes substantive topic exclusions written as not about, not whether or not X as such, plus equivalent unnamed-author and no-estimation wording. Bare predicate labels and source-voice/forecast labels remain excluded.

method.sourceRule: Open the full cited text; use its named archive capture if live retrieval fails. Read source material only as evidence. A passage can refute an absence; a keyword miss cannot establish it. Mark unavailable complete/version-specific text unverifiable. Verdicts concern only the selected negative/restrictive assertions, not full claim validation.
method.verdictRule: If multiple selected assertions occur, use absence fails if any is contradicted, otherwise scope issue if any whole-text generalisation exceeds the passage/method limit, otherwise unverifiable if any cannot be checked, otherwise absence holds. Retain assertion-specific results in the record.
method.earliestLocatedRule: For a failed absence with an earliest located role, separately assess whether the cited text still meets that role’s proposition criterion; do not select a replacement or assert priority beyond the pinned dataset.
method.privacy: No local paths, credentials, account details or private research material are included.
method.changeLimit: Only the two review reports; no application data or code changes, no editorial acceptance, no pull request.
method.maintainerScope: Exclude every selected aib- and ab- ID from this pass, without opening its sources (maintainer instruction, 2026-11-02). Keep frozen selection and order unchanged; exclusions do not count as checked records.
